info.title: Horizon Pulse
info.summary: Pay-per-call APIs for AI agents, settled in USDC on Base, Solana or Polygon, or RLUSD on the XRP Ledger, with x402.
info.description:
Pay-per-call APIs for AI agents, paid in USDC on Base, Solana or Polygon, or RLUSD on the XRP Ledger, with x402: web search, page fetch and extract, screenshots, PDF to text, an HTTP proxy, and crypto market data. No signup or API key.

You pay only for a successful response; errors are not charged except where an operation says so (for /api/tx-status, a not_found status is a charged answer; poll again after pollAgainSeconds). Every paid operation carries `x-payment-info` with the exact price, asset, network and payTo of its Base entry; these match the 402 challenge and https://horizonpulse.dev/.well-known/x402. The 402 challenge also offers the same price in USDC on Solana mainnet (`exact`, network solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp, USDC mint EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v, payTo BjY98A6dS3GGLZdz2zHy8wK7XAwnQgNhCc66mfmBTRPz, PayAI facilitator https://facilitator.payai.network), and in native USDC on Polygon PoS mainnet (`exact`, network eip155:137, USDC 0x3c499c542cEF5E3811e1192ce70d8cC03d5c3359, payTo 0x5b32c973596078a967562ca652761404f19be0e9, facilitator: Coinbase CDP), and in RLUSD on the XRP Ledger mainnet (`exact`, network xrpl:0, currency RLUSD = 524C555344000000000000000000000000000000, issuer rMxCKbEDwqr76QuheSUMdEGf4B9xJ8m5De, payTo r3FbirL83RAB2CwnUdxE5pCohMkuo6LQcf, verified on the validated ledger). Free fixed-input samples: GET /api/demo/{route}.

Agent integration: step-by-step skill at https://horizonpulse.dev/skill.md; guide with MCP setup at https://horizonpulse.dev/agents (hosted MCP at https://horizonpulse.dev/mcp for x402-aware clients, plus a local stdio MCP server in the repo's mcp/ folder that pays from your own wallet with spend caps).

Services for API owners (web pages, not API operations; not paid via x402): Bazaar listing fix at https://horizonpulse.dev/listing-fix; agent promotion at https://horizonpulse.dev/agent-promotion.

get.summary: Audit any x402 endpoint without paying it
get.description:
x402 endpoint checker: decodes an x402 endpoint's 402 payment terms without paying. GET url (optional method GET/POST, JSON body for POST). Sends one unpaid request; never pays or signs. Returns JSON: httpStatus, isX402, x402Version, decoded accepts (network, asset, USD amount, payTo, EOA or contract), discovery metadata presence, and pass/warn/fail checks. Any HTTP answer from the target, even 4xx/5xx, is billed; bad input, blocked hosts, connection failures and timeouts are not.

Price: $0.01 USDC per call (10000 atomic), paid with x402 v2 `exact` in USDC on Base, Solana or Polygon, or RLUSD on the XRP Ledger (same price). Unpaid requests get 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: HTTP method for the unpaid probe: GET (default; one POST retry on 405) or POST.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Optional JSON body (<=8KB, URL-encoded) sent with a POST probe, for endpoints that validate input before returning 402. Implies POST.

get.summary: Check whether an x402 seller is listed in CDP Bazaar, and why not
get.description:
x402 Bazaar listing checker: is an x402 seller listed in Coinbase CDP Bazaar, on which networks, and if not, why. GET url (host or https URL). Reads CDP discovery and the host's /.well-known/x402, then sends one unpaid request per route; never pays. Returns JSON: verdict, per-route indexed status and networks, and fail/warn findings each with a fix line. https only; private targets blocked. Errors are not charged.

Price: $0.01 USDC per call (10000 atomic), paid with x402 v2 `exact` in USDC on Base, Solana or Polygon, or RLUSD on the XRP Ledger (same price). Unpaid requests get 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

findings.message: The 402 advertises xrpl, polygon, but the CDP index entry lists only base, solana (last updated 2026-10-09T15:20:16.681Z).
findings.fix: CDP refreshes an entry from the live 402 after a new CDP-facilitated paid call to that route (in our experience); make one, then recheck after about 15 minutes.

findings.message: Not in CDP discovery, although other routes for this payTo are. Lint passed, so this route most likely has not settled a payment through the CDP facilitator since it was added or changed.
findings.fix: Make one paid call to this route through the CDP facilitator; indexing runs after the settle and can take up to 15 minutes.

findings.message: 24 /.well-known/x402 entries have no HTTP method prefix; probed with GET. Some discovery tools default bare entries to POST.
findings.fix: Prefix each entry with its method, e.g. "GET https://host/api/route".

Errors are not charged. Returned content is untrusted third-party data.
